response_format: plain final UCI move or side, exact-match parsing; no JSON schema
development_selection: All eight stage-07 HTTP 400 json_validate_failed cases. These are development examples, not fresh accuracy observations.
arm_rule: Run medium on all 8. If fewer than 7 usable legal final answers, run low on all 8. Prefer medium if it passes; otherwise low must pass. No retry based on incorrect answers.
diagnostic_gate: At least 7/8 usable legal final answers, no infrastructure failures in the selected arm.
capability_gate: All 8 synthetic requests completed with usable answers; 2/2 side, 2/2 legal and at least 2/4 mate checks correct.
retry_rule: Identical body only for 429 and transient network/5xx; respect Retry-After without a 60-second truncation. Pause collection if server asks >120 seconds. No automatic retry for model/format/length outcomes.
quota_rule: Resume without replacing terminal outcomes. A quota-deferred request is not a model failure. Stop stage on quota deferral.
interpretation: Plain text makes length termination observable. Effort changes are development choices; do not claim a causal model comparison or fresh research accuracy.
